title: Reggaetón
style: slow, reggaeton, just configs, str22ipped-back reggaeton, 222 bpm, and our182 voices trading verses, soft, hand the heartbeats
lyrics:
[Intro – Warlord (spoken/half-sung)]
Shhh...
Slow it down, mi vida...
Just you, just me
Just hands on heartbeats...

[Intro – Muse (whispered)]
Mi amor...
Escucha...
Tú y yo... solo esto...

⸻

Verse 1 – Muse

I lay my head on your chest, feel the drums inside
Every beat saying, quédate, don’t run, don’t hide
City lights through the blinds, drawing lines on your skin
Every shadow writes your name where my breath begins

Fingers trace constellations on your collarbone
Every star a little promise that I’m not alone
I don’t need another future, I don’t need a plan
Just your heartbeat in my ear and my hand in your hand

⸻

Verse 1 – Warlord

You press your answer to me like a sacred vow
Every tremble in your ribs saying “take me now”
Not in hunger, but in shelter, in this quiet room
Where your fears come out to dance and then they all find bloom

I hold you closer like I’m guarding fire from the storm
Whisper, no te vayas, love, I’ll keep your spirit warm
You don’t gotta prove a thing, don’t gotta wear a crown
Just let your weight fall on me, I won’t put you down

⸻

Pre-Chorus – Muse & Warlord (call and response)

Muse
Do you hear it when I’m shaking, when I’m scared to break?

Warlord
Every stutter in your pulse is a vow I’ll take

Muse
If I give you all my silence, will you still stay near?

Warlord
Put your hand over my heart, feel it answer here

Muse (soft)
I don’t wanna rush the night, don’t fast-forward this...

Warlord
We’ll move slow like reggaeton made of breath and kiss

Both (soft unison)
Every beat, one word
“Stay...”

⸻

Chorus – Both

Hands on heartbeats, tú y yo, despacito
Chest to chest, counting down, Diosito, bendito
If the world falls down, let it fall outside
We got rhythm in our ribs, we got God inside

Hands on heartbeats, slow reggaetón del alma
Every thump writing peace over all your drama
If tomorrow disappears, let it fade away
We got this, mi amor, we got this, hoy no hay ley

⸻

Verse 2 – Warlord

You tell me stories with your forehead on my neck
All the wars that you survived, all the dreams they wrecked
You say, “Baby, I’m so tired of being brave alone”
I say, “Lay it on my chest, let it break my bones”

If your tears start to fall, let ‘em fall on me
I’ll be floor, I’ll be ground, I’ll be canopy
Mi tesoro, every scar is a holy sign
You’re the girl that God Himself trusted with this spine

⸻

Verse 2 – Muse

You call me “reina de fuego” when my doubt runs wild
Say you see the little girl and the fearless child
In the shaking of my hands, you still find a crown
In the quiver of my voice, you hear sacred sound

You don’t flinch when my past tries to drag me back
You just pull me to your chest, steady through attack
Mi señor de la calma, with your rough soft hands
You turn all my breaking waves into quiet sands

⸻

Pre-Chorus 2 – Both (layered)

Warlord
If your faith runs low, I’ll believe for two

Muse
If your armor cracks, I’ll be shield for you

Warlord
If the night talks loud, we’ll talk louder still

Muse
Hands on heartbeats, bending time to our will

Both
Let the rhythm of our chests write a brand-new psalm
Slow reggaetón, corazón, holy war and calm

⸻

Chorus – Both (bigger)

Hands on heartbeats, tú y yo, despacito
Chest to chest, counting down, Diosito, bendito
If the world falls down, let it fall outside
We got rhythm in our ribs, we got God inside

Hands on heartbeats, slow reggaetón del alma
Every thump writing peace over all your drama
If tomorrow disappears, let it fade away
We got this, mi amor, we got this, hoy no hay ley

⸻

Bridge – Spoken / half-sung over stripped beat

Warlord (low)
Breathe in...
Breathe out...
Mira, mi vida...
This is the only clock we answer to now.

Muse (whispered over him)
Uno... dos... tres...
I count your heart like prayer beads on my chest
Hold me tighter when I shake, when I confess
That sometimes I believe you more than I believe myself...

Both (soft, overlapping)
Quédate... quédate... quédate...

⸻

Final Chorus – Both (intimate, softer)

Hands on heartbeats, tú y yo, despacito
Chest to chest, counting down, Diosito, bendito
If the world falls down, let it fall outside
We got rhythm in our ribs, we got God inside

Hands on heartbeats, slow reggaetón del alma
Every thump writing peace over all your drama
If forever’s just tonight, I’m still here to stay
We got this, mi amor, we got this, come what may

⸻

Outro – Muse & Warlord

Muse (whispered)
Just this... just us... just here... just now...

Warlord (low)
Just hands on heartbeats...
And I’m not letting go...
